seo.meta_description: Pizza Hut is owned by Yum! Brands, the same parent as KFC and Taco Bell. Here's the full ownership story behind the pizza chain.

question: Who Owns Pizza Hut?
quick_answer: Pizza Hut is owned by Yum! Brands, a publicly traded company that also owns KFC and Taco Bell. Pizza Hut was founded in 1958 by brothers Dan and Frank Carney in Wichita, Kansas. It became part of the company now known as Yum! Brands, which was spun off from PepsiCo in 1997.
key_facts: Sister brands: KFC and Taco Bell
Yum! Brands was spun off from PepsiCo in 1997

body.heading: Who owns Pizza Hut?
body.text: Pizza Hut is part of Yum! Brands, one of the world's biggest restaurant companies. Yum! Brands is publicly traded and also owns KFC and Taco Bell, so Pizza Hut shares a parent with those two chains.

body.heading: The brand's roots
body.text: Pizza Hut was founded in 1958 by brothers Dan and Frank Carney in Wichita, Kansas, using money borrowed from their mother. It grew into one of the largest pizza chains in the world, known for its pan pizza and, for years, its red-roof dine-in restaurants.

body.heading: How it became part of Yum!
body.text: PepsiCo owned Pizza Hut for a time, then spun off its restaurant business, including Pizza Hut, KFC and Taco Bell, in 1997. That spin-off became Tricon and was later renamed Yum! Brands, which still owns Pizza Hut today.

faqs.q: Is Pizza Hut owned by the same company as KFC?
faqs.a: Yes. Pizza Hut, KFC and Taco Bell are all owned by Yum! Brands.
